author: Lord_O_Fire
body:
IGN: Lord_O_Fire was Fire11 when banned.
Screenshot link: http://postimg.org/image/jcfh29v1f/
Reason For Ban: On ban screen it says that I have hacked with "Regen" and "Anti Knockback" on August 8 2014. Then it was version 1.7.10 and there where alot of hack clients that had "Session ID Hack" for version 1.7.10. Me and my friend Jonniz01 believe that another hacker used "Session ID Hack" on me and hacked with the hacks above. We sadly have no proof of this. I don't think that I have ever used a hack client!
Why should you unban me: It's been 2 years now and I do not remember using a hack on Avicus ever. I was really looking forwards to playing with my friend Jonniz01 and we got surprised when we saw that i was banned. I hope to be able to play on Avicus in the near future. I am playing as silkroader65 at the moment but can't do that forever. I have not done anything bad on that account(And Not On The Other Account Either).
